title: JSON-mode assertion and constrained-decoder resilience test matrix
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Provide a reproducible, CI-run test matrix that asserts JSON-mode enforcement and constrained-decoder behavior across streaming, tool-calling, and partial-output scenarios. This ticket covers the test design, harness implementation, integration into GitHub Actions, and runbook for failures. Motivation: recent customer regressions where streaming partial responses broke downstream JSON parsers, and tool-calls produced invalid shapes when constrained decoding fell back. Scope: - Test cases for strict-json, relaxed-json-with-fallback, and constrained-decoder backoff. - Streaming reconstruction tests (fragment reassembly, partial close, mid-stream schema violations). - Tool-calling interleaving tests where model emits both tool calls and structured JSON in same stream. - Cross-model matrix: open models + quantized variants + model-compatibility shim. - Metrics and thresholds: schema-adherence-rate, first-json-latency, reassembly-failure-rate. Out of scope: retraining models or changing model logits; this is a runtime/harness/CI validation effort only.
acceptance_criteria: Matrix runs in CI for PRs that touch runtime streaming/decoder code (GitHub Actions job 'jsonmode-matrix').
Defines at least 120 distinct test vectors covering: short/long sequences, nested schemas, streaming interruptions, tool-call interleaving, and adversarial prompts.
Aggregate schema-adherence >=99% for non-adversarial vectors, and documented expected failure modes for adversarial vectors.
Constrained-decoder backoff behavior validated: when constrained decoder fails, fallback path produces documented shape and logs a clear signal for telemetry.
Runbook created: triage steps, links to failing trace, recommended mitigations (prompt transformation, decoder tuning, fallback mapping).
Dashboard tile added to Console QA space with daily job pass rate and top failing prompts.
Prototype harness merged and exercised against staging runtime-1.19 pool without regressions for 72 hours.
Canary gating: blocked PRs show test failures; releases to production must include green results for runtime-1.19 and one quantized variant.
tasks: Design canonical set of JSON schemas (flat, nested, arrays, optional keys) and adversarial variants
Implement harness that can replay streaming fragments and reconstruct messages for the constrained decoder
Add prompt generator that emits edge-case tokens (unclosed braces, embedded code blocks, repeated separators)
Integrate matrix into GitHub Actions with parallel shards by model + decoder-mode
Hook CI outcomes to Console QA dashboard and a flaky-tolerance alert
Write runbook and troubleshooting checklist; link to telemetry traces/OTEL spans
Perform 72-hour soak against staging runtime-1.19 and capture baseline metrics
